ui.settings.groups.title: Group management
ui.settings.groups.description: Members can belong to several groups; switching the group in the top bar narrows file visibility, permissions and todos
ui.settings.groups.empty_description: Click “New group” in the top right to define visibility and permissions for different teams
ui.settings.groups.editor_description: Groups only narrow things down: visibility and permissions can only be tightened within the global scope set by a super admin, never widened.
ui.settings.groups.delete_confirm_descri: The group's memberships and visibility scope will be deleted too, and its todos will become visible to everyone.
ui.settings.groups.name_hint: Up to 40 characters; letters, digits, spaces and _ . - are allowed
ui.settings.groups.leader_caps_hint: A super admin can delegate these to group leaders; any capability left unchecked is unavailable to leaders in this group.
ui.settings.groups.leader_caps_manage_me: Manage this group's members and visibility scope
ui.settings.groups.no_members_hint: No members yet — add some on the “Members” tab first
ui.settings.groups.member_hint: Removing a member also removes their leader role.
ui.settings.groups.perm_group_file_ops_h: When the “File operations master switch” is off, every write permission in this group stops working.
ui.settings.groups.perms_hint: These switches can only turn off permissions already granted globally on the “Permissions” tab; they cannot re-enable anything that is off globally.
ui.settings.groups.whitelist_placeholder:
One folder per line, relative to the share root:
ProjectA
Public
ui.settings.groups.whitelist_hint: Leave empty for no restriction; otherwise members can only see these folders and their subfolders.
ui.settings.groups.blacklist_placeholder:
One folder per line:
Confidential
Financials
ui.settings.groups.blacklist_hint: Takes priority over the whitelist: anything matching both is always hidden. To members, hidden folders simply do not exist.
ui.settings.data.avatar_description: Both the server and the web app use 128×128 WebP; clients cache them in IndexedDB and skip re-downloading unchanged ones
ui.settings.data.avatar_enabled_hint: When off, neither members nor super admins can upload or change avatars
ui.settings.data.todos_description: Controls whether the “Team” page is available
ui.settings.data.todos_enabled_hint: When off, no member can see the todo feature
ui.settings.data.default_visibility_desc: Applies to members in no group, or when “Default” is selected in the top bar. An empty whitelist means no restriction; the blacklist wins
ui.settings.data.pick_hint: “Choose from folders” appends a line; you still have to click Save for it to take effect
ui.settings.data.retention_description: Controls disk and memory usage; logs are rotated and cleaned up daily
ui.settings.data.metrics_enabled_hint: Tracks QPS, status code distribution and slow requests
ui.settings.data.backup_description: Snapshots automatically before overwriting, plus a daily snapshot; keeping the latest {n}
ui.settings.data.backup_enabled_hint: When off, nothing is written to data/backups/ (both the pre-overwrite snapshot and the daily snapshot stop)
ui.settings.data.backup_hint: Backups live in data/backups/ and cover six data files: config/users/groups/todos/shares/plugins.
ui.settings.data.restore_confirm_descrip: The selected backup will overwrite the current “{name}”. The current state is snapshotted first so you can undo this.
ui.settings.data.restored: Rolled back, please refresh the page
ui.settings.logs.system_metrics_descript: Sampled every minute; memory covers the last {n} minutes and on-disk files are pruned by “Metrics kept on disk” (adjustable under “Data & retention”)
ui.settings.logs.audit_description: Sign-ins, permission changes, file operations and system events
ui.settings.trash.title: Trash
ui.settings.trash.description_prefix: Deleted items are kept here first and cleaned up automatically once retention expires
ui.settings.trash.enabled_label: Move deleted items to the trash
ui.settings.trash.enabled_hint: When off, deletions take effect immediately and no copy is kept
ui.settings.trash.unavailable_prefix: The trash folder is currently unavailable (for example data/ is read-only or the disk is full), so
ui.settings.trash.unavailable_strong: deletions take effect immediately and do not go to the trash
ui.settings.trash.restore_confirm_descri: The content will go back to its original location. If an item with the same name is already there, the restore is refused and you must resolve the conflict first.
ui.settings.trash.overwrite_confirm_titl: Overwrite “{path}” with the version in the trash?
ui.settings.trash.overwrite_confirm_desc: The item with the same name in that location will be deleted, and this cannot be undone.
ui.settings.trash.overwrite_hint: Overwrite with the version in the trash when names conflict
ui.settings.trash.purge_confirm_descript: The content will be permanently deleted and can no longer be restored.
ui.settings.trash.empty_confirm_descript: All {n} items in the trash will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
ui.settings.trash.hint: “Restore” puts the item back where it was; if an item with the same name is already there, use “Overwrite and restore” first, or rename or delete the conflicting item. Items past their retention period are cleaned up when the server starts or by the maintenance job that runs every 6 hours.
